text:
maria: Heads up — p99 latency jumped to ~1.8s on runtime-6 starting 12:02 UTC. queue_depth metric spiked to ~240. Any ideas on noisy tenant or kernel churn?
kevin: seeing the same. kernel logs show repeated kernel swap between amx-opt and fp16-fallback, lots of reselects.
zack: can we throttle the heavy tenants? propose throttling tenant T-42 and routing to a fallback model cluster for the burst.
sophia: checking KV cache — hit rate dropped from ~92% to ~30% during the spike. lots of evictions. this aligns with the kernel churn.
jamal: running a quick flameprof on runtime-6 now, will paste hotspots when ready.
maria: incident-bot: create incident "runtime-latency-runtime-6" priority P1
incident-bot: Incident runtime-latency-runtime-6 created by maria. Channel #eng-runtime-incident-1859001234
kevin: quick mitigation idea: flip feature flag ff.batch.resize to 0.6 for runtime-6 to reduce queue pressure and coalescing latency.
zack: also suggest route T-42 to cpu-fallback-cluster for 15m while we stabilize.
sophia: small KV tweak: temporarily extend prefix cache TTL for active keys for T-42. I can patch infra config in ~2m.
jamal: flameprof done — hotspots look like: 
```text
hotspots:
  1. kernel_select() 48%
  2. kv_cache.evict 22%
  3. batching.coalesce 14%
```
maria: thanks. Kevin — can you push the FF change? I'll open the routing change.
kevin: pushing FF change now: `./deploy-ff --env prod --flag ff.batch.resize --val 0.6 --target runtime-6`
infra-bot: Feature flag ff.batch.resize -> 0.6 applied to runtime-6 by kevin at 12:08 UTC
zack: routing change applied: T-42 -> cpu-fallback-cluster for 15m
maria: monitoring: queue_depth down to ~80, p99 trending to ~700ms and falling.
sophia: KV hit rate climbing back to ~88% after TTL extension.
jamal: also applied kernel selection override to prefer stable-kernel-v2 on runtime-6: `kubectl set env ds/runtime-6 KERNEL_OVERRIDE=stable-v2`
infra-bot: Kernel override for runtime-6 set to stable-v2 by jamal
kevin: will follow up with a permanent batching tweak and adjust kernel-selection thresholds. creating ticket INF-4321 for postmortem + fixes.
maria: good work. keep updates here. if p99 < 500ms sustained for 15m we can close.
zack: :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident runtime-latency-runtime-6 auto-closed after metrics recovered (p99 < 500ms for 20m)
